model.adapter: LayerNorm -> Linear -> GELU -> Dropout -> zero-init Linear -> residual add
model.j1_initialization: new adapter seed0; copy selected J0 heads; no DSTE/ADL loaded or optimized

training.loss: sum of SAFER and FU CE; each has train-only inverse-sqrt class counts normalized by mean; absent count clamped1
training.sampling: one pass shuffled SAFER per epoch; each step one FU32 batch, cycle independent shuffled train-only FU indices without dropping samples
training.shuffle: CPU generator seed+2*epoch for SAFER and seed+2*epoch+1 for FU; epoch starts at1
training.selection: final fixed-duration epoch; no epoch selection

training.class_weight: train-only inverse-sqrt counts normalized by mean; absent count clamp1
training.shuffle: CPU torch.Generator seed+epoch, same order for G0/G1/G2, drop_last=false
training.selection: per-variant validation macroF1 then conditional fall-vs-lie AP; exact ties earliest epoch
training.holdout: test/ood features, labels and metrics only after selection lock; no retuning

feature_contract: Corrected confidence-alignment DSTE pooled features; SAFER 25Hz reference-frame labels; FU native30 clip mean; no feature scaling
